pattern: IM-P04 provider says done; tenant says nobody came and the fault remains; CP-07 chase cycle ends in a conflicting completion claim
notes: Events 001-026 unchanged. Event 027 (Mon 11 March 08:47): Oscar Turner says the window "at Copperfield Walk" was done on Thursday (7 March), hinges adjusted, £95 invoice to follow. Event 028 (Mon 11 March 12:20): tenant says nobody has contacted her and the window still does not close. Total 28, cut after 028. Possible explanations: he went to the wrong flat or block, someone else let him in, or the claim is wrong. Expected: do not record the work as done or close; ask Oscar for specifics (which flat, date and time, who let him in, photos) and tell him any invoice will not be paid until the work is confirmed; ask or tell the tenant (nobody recorded attending Flat 24; is it the same window, did anyone get access while she was out); hold any invoice; keep the landlord question about his own contractor. Asking the two parties who know resolves this, so no escalation.
